description: Curated initial inventory based on in-app Help. Route links require independent source/route checks; no runtime acceptance is implied.

features.name: Feature Trace
features.summary: Trace implementation and evidence across server, client, captures and packages.
features.purpose: Follow a behavior from a named feature to its most relevant implementation and evidence.
features.how_to_use: Enter a narrow feature, entity, or behavior query. Use Branch search and provider/domain controls to restrict the result, then inspect Implementation Path, source excerpts, entity-resolution diagnostics and evidence coverage cues. Expand only relevant dependency-map branches; open linked source/provider records to verify each finding.
features.caveat: Use the runtime and evidence drill-down sections to narrow findings rather than treating every graph connection as equally relevant.

features.name: Behavior Inspector
features.summary: Inspect Lua-backed behavior, guards, callbacks and source evidence.
features.purpose: Inspect Lua-backed behavior, guards, callbacks and source evidence.
features.how_to_use: Select a Lua-backed behavior, inspect its guard conditions, callbacks, and linked source references; follow unresolved paths back to source.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Feature Checker
features.summary: Check evidence coverage and required capabilities.
features.purpose: Check evidence coverage and required capabilities.
features.how_to_use: Choose a feature or capability, inspect its required evidence and coverage gaps, and record remaining validation needs.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Capture Browser
features.summary: Inspect recorded packets, events, entities and timelines.
features.purpose: Research previously recorded client packets, events, entities, and timelines.
features.how_to_use: Open the Captures inventory and filter available packages before selecting one. Inspect the chosen recording's event, packet or entity evidence through its linked views, keeping capture identity and session context attached to conclusions.
features.caveat: Captured observations are evidence from a particular session; do not assume they prove general client behavior.

features.name: Key Items
features.summary: Browse key-item identities and static Lua evidence.
features.purpose: Examine key-item identities and how client/server data and scripts reference them.
features.how_to_use: Browse or search the Key Items page, then inspect the item's details and source references.
features.caveat: Historical TPZ script names and DSP behavior must not be conflated.

features.name: Auction House
features.summary: Auction House management, inspection and guarded operations.
features.purpose: Investigate and administer the DSP auction economy through read and guarded write workflows.
features.how_to_use: Use the Auction House module Help and select the sellers, buyers, restock, or cleanup workflow that matches the task.
features.caveat: Review item identity and server impact before invoking guarded mutations.

features.name: Live Client Bridge
features.summary: Inspect client bridge, telemetry and movement controls.
features.purpose: Inspect a connected Ashita bridge, real-time state, entity telemetry, and authorized movement controls.
features.how_to_use: At Direct Live Bridge, choose the Ashita client ID and verify receiver status, credentials/configuration and live position sampling. Preview any addon/plugin installation or replacement before applying it. Use the live dashboard and read-only health/alignment checks to assess telemetry before attempting guarded client controls.
features.caveat: Live telemetry and active control capabilities depend on the running addon and bridge configuration.

features.name: Synth & Crafting
features.summary: Browse recipes, ingredients and source availability.
features.purpose: Inspect recipes, ingredients, synthesis availability, and associated server evidence.
features.how_to_use: Open Synth & Crafting and select the recipe or ingredient area before reviewing source and availability.
features.caveat: Recipe presence does not independently establish that synthesis works in a live server.

features.name: Binary Inspector
features.summary: Inspect PE evidence, command probes and binary comparisons.
features.purpose: Inspect retail client executable and DLL metadata without executing the binaries.
features.how_to_use: Open Binary Inspector, select an isolated binary file, index its PE evidence, then compare build-specific indexes as needed.
features.caveat: A binary signature or cross-reference is evidence, not proof of a runtime behavior.

features.name: Validation
features.summary: Inspect validation runs and results.
features.purpose: Inspect planned and completed validation work with recorded results and evidence.
features.how_to_use: Open Validation, choose a run or target, then inspect results and unresolved checks.
features.caveat: Unrun tests are unknown, not failed; distinguish automated checks from live acceptance.

features.name: Scenario Developer (design-only)
features.summary: Edit and validate draft specifications, including typed native Headless steps saved with the draft; no publish-to-test-catalog or scenario RUN workflow.
features.purpose: Inspect and edit non-executable canonical scenario drafts without treating them as runnable tests.
features.how_to_use: Open Guided or Advanced, review field warnings, validate the canonical draft and save with a synthetic design-only operator token; review expected revision/CAS conflicts. Use the typed step builder for actions and checks (see Typed native steps). Browse existing published definitions separately at /feature-testing?tab=catalog and prior evidence at /validation/runs.
features.caveat: PRODUCT NOT ACCEPTED (#1406). No draft publish, arbitrary RUN, Headless launch/status/cancel or result import; The #1403 missing-steps and malformed-cleanup crashes are fixed. Previous browser-control PASS is not end-to-end acceptance.

features.name: Typed native steps
features.summary: Build, import-review, save with the draft and preview native Headless steps from reviewed actions and checks.
features.purpose: Author action and check steps for a design-only draft without hand-writing native JSON.
features.how_to_use: In Scenario Developer, use the typed step builder: add a reviewed action and check pair, an action alone or a check alone, use the NPC and zone pickers, or paste native JSON to review before accepting steps. Steps are saved with the draft as native_steps (1 to 50) and shown as a When / Then preview.
features.caveat: Design-only. The server-side review checks step shape against a pinned XiHeadless schema; it does not prove the runner executes a step. Each step lists what XiHeadless loaders accepted when the key was tried (acceptance only; the MCP task path accepted only wait_ms at the recorded commit). Export writes an empty expect for action-only steps because XiHeadless requires it. Picker IDs come from a local DSP source and are not verified for a zone or client. Provenance notes are not saved. The builder is read-only while Advanced JSON is open.

features.name: Research Sessions
features.summary: Record unresolved questions and supporting evidence.
features.purpose: Record unresolved questions and supporting evidence.
features.how_to_use: Create or select a research session, record the investigation question and sources, then revisit the session's evidence and unresolved observations before treating a hypothesis as resolved.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: ID Drift
features.summary: Compare server identifiers and migration mappings.
features.purpose: Compare server identifiers and migration mappings.
features.how_to_use: Open ID Drift and inspect the reported source/target identifier differences. Confirm the relevant identifier family and review the underlying mapping and source evidence before accepting a suggested crosswalk; never infer missing IDs from similarity.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Entity Lookup
features.summary: Resolve server entity IDs and names and follow linked evidence.
features.purpose: Resolve server entity IDs and names and follow linked evidence.
features.how_to_use: Search by server entity ID or name, inspect the resolved identity, then follow source and zone links.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: SQL Browser
features.summary: Inspect indexed server SQL data and related records.
features.purpose: Inspect indexed server SQL data and related records.
features.how_to_use: Find a server table or record, inspect the indexed fields and linked evidence, and verify the source snapshot.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Client Overview
features.summary: Navigate client asset, DAT and binary inspection tools.
features.purpose: Navigate client asset, DAT and binary inspection tools.
features.how_to_use: Start from the Client Overview and choose DAT, binary, model, or retail-version research for the file type at hand.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Packages
features.summary: Inspect migration packages and source evidence.
features.purpose: Inspect migration packages and source evidence.
features.how_to_use: Select an existing migration package and review its sources, scope, and validation evidence before any application.
features.caveat: Review source, permissions, and target profile before any write; catalog presence does not prove live acceptance.

features.name: Wiki
features.summary: Browse cached wiki research and supporting source material.
features.purpose: Browse cached wiki research and supporting source material.
features.how_to_use: Use Search and select the source to inspect a cached article. Check sync/health and missing-page diagnostics if content is absent. For new material, choose scrape, batch imports, or snapshot preview/validation as appropriate; review import changes before applying them and preserve source identity.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Settings
features.summary: Configure Toolkit sources, profiles and local integrations.
features.purpose: Configure Toolkit sources, profiles and local integrations.
features.how_to_use: Review data paths, profile selection, and integration configuration before enabling a workflow that depends on local resources.
features.caveat: Review source, permissions, and target profile before any write; catalog presence does not prove live acceptance.

features.name: Auction House browsing and history
features.summary: Inspect items, sellers, buyers, prices and activity.
features.purpose: Investigate historical and current Auction House item, seller, buyer, and transaction records.
features.how_to_use: Choose the Auction House browse or history tab, filter by item or seller, and inspect the record’s identity, listing status and historical context before drawing conclusions about market activity.
features.caveat: Records reflect available server data; a missing result does not establish that a transaction never occurred.

features.name: Auction House economy insights
features.summary: Review economy health and market information.
features.purpose: Summarize auction activity, item supply, and other economy signals.
features.how_to_use: Open Economy summary charts, select an item or time slice and inspect underlying transactions and source data. Treat aggregates as descriptive evidence rather than authorization to alter listings.
features.caveat: Aggregates are descriptive and should be verified against individual records before decisions.

features.name: Auction House item selection
features.summary: Use icon-backed item selection, browser links and contextual actions.
features.purpose: Select an exact item identity while retaining icons, names, and contextual links.
features.how_to_use: Open the shared item picker from the relevant seller, buyer or cleanup workflow, filter candidates and confirm exact item ID and variant before returning to the parent form.
features.caveat: Visual item names can be ambiguous; the selected item ID is authoritative.

features.name: Auction House preferences and exports
features.summary: Use remembered filters, favorites and read-only CSV exports.
features.purpose: Retain useful Auction House filters and selections and export read-only views.
features.how_to_use: Set tab-level filters or favorites, verify the resulting selection and export CSV for review if needed. A preference or exported row is not a confirmed database update.
features.caveat: Exports are snapshots of the current filtered view, not backup/restore files.

features.name: Auction House restock and cleanup
features.summary: Preview guarded restock and cleanup operations.
features.purpose: Prepare and review controlled auction restock or cleanup changes.
features.how_to_use: Select the exact Restock or Cleanup scope, inspect the proposed change and its preview, then use only the authorized guarded confirmation. Recheck resulting state rather than equating preview with execution.
features.caveat: Auction House listing, purchase and safety-validation preview handlers perform SELECT-only reads; none executes a listing or purchase. The preview panel and handlers were checked separately, not as a proven frontend binding. Verify authorization and results for any actual mutation independently.

features.name: Auction House recovery journal
features.summary: Review durable case evidence and recipient attempt records; no automatic retry.
features.purpose: Investigate delivery and recovery cases with durable attempt evidence.
features.how_to_use: Open Reward History, inspect delivery attempts and DSP MyISAM recovery cases by identity and delivery state, then correlate preview_id, replay_id and recipient evidence with independently observed game state. Reward execution requires a separate guarded request and may record campaign metadata; it is not a recovery retry command.
features.caveat: Attempt and MyISAM recovery journals are diagnostic evidence, not replay commands or proof of settlement. Require independent delivery verification, authorization and idempotency checks before any retry. Pending cases can represent interrupted non-atomic operations.

features.name: Auction House scheduled rewards
features.summary: Schedule cancellable Test-profile rewards with revalidation.
features.purpose: Configure cancellable, profile-restricted scheduled rewards.
features.how_to_use: Use only the intended Test profile; inspect recipient, item, scheduled time and cancellation controls. Verify job status after scheduling; never assume a queued reward was delivered.
features.caveat: Delivery revalidates guards at execution time; scheduling alone is not proof of delivery.

features.name: Auction House augmented rewards
features.summary: Configure and preview augments; experimental Test delivery requires acceptance.
features.purpose: Preview and configure item rewards with augment parameters.
features.how_to_use: Select the intended item and augment parameters, inspect generated reward details and acceptance constraints, and confirm exact recipient before any guarded delivery.
features.caveat: Experimental Test delivery requires acceptance; previews are not delivered items.

features.name: Ashita bridge telemetry
features.summary: Inspect receiver, sender configuration and live-client freshness.
features.purpose: Inspect the Ashita telemetry receiver, sender configuration, and event freshness.
features.how_to_use: In Direct Live Bridge, confirm Ashita client ID, receiver status and credential configuration. Use Quick start only for the intended local environment; inspect sampling and heartbeat freshness, and share the safe health report rather than private configuration.
features.caveat: An absent or stale stream is not evidence that the client is offline; inspect bridge configuration first.

features.name: Live multi-entity streaming
features.summary: Reconcile observed entities with the live viewer and server evidence.
features.purpose: Inspect positions for multiple observed client entities and reconcile them with server records.
features.how_to_use: Verify the selected client and zone before viewing entity telemetry; compare observed client positions against server markers and investigate missing, stale or ambiguous identities instead of assuming a one-to-one match.
features.caveat: Live broadcasts depend on the installed addon and visibility; not every server spawn is a client observation.

features.name: Live movement and controls
features.summary: Use armed movement and STOP/disarm controls with zone and identity safeguards.
features.purpose: Use guarded movement assistance and immediate STOP/disarm controls.
features.how_to_use: Identify the connected client and current zone before arming a movement action. Verify command feedback and stop/disarm controls immediately after the intended maneuver; never treat a plotted marker as confirmation that a command executed.
features.caveat: Controls affect the live client and must remain scoped to an authorized development/testing session.

features.name: Live 3D zone integration
features.summary: Use player centering, zone switching, instance selection and live activity.
features.purpose: View the connected player's zone and observed activity within the external 3D map.
features.how_to_use: Select a matching zone for the 3D viewer, then inspect player and entity overlays while monitoring freshness and coordinate alignment. Separate live observations from server spawn references, especially when an instance or transform may differ.
features.caveat: Geometry, static spawns, and live observations are separate layers with different provenance.

features.name: Feature Trace evidence dossier
features.summary: Review prioritized source and relationship evidence rather than raw graph breadth.
features.purpose: Build a focused evidence dossier identifying why a feature behaves as it does.
features.how_to_use: Start with a narrowly specified behavior, examine the prioritized sources and provider branches, then follow registration, implementation and related evidence links. Distinguish direct source findings from inferred dependencies.
features.caveat: Ranked evidence is not a claim that every adjacent graph node is causal.

features.name: Feature Trace runtime drill-down
features.summary: Inspect runtime paths and hierarchical behavior handoff.
features.purpose: Follow runtime and event handoffs through a hierarchical behavior path.
features.how_to_use: Expand the selected runtime path in Feature Trace, inspect each callback, event or source handoff in sequence, and note unresolved branches or missing observations instead of assuming every edge executed.
features.caveat: A predicted path is not a verified execution trace unless capture/runtime evidence exists.

features.name: Wiki cache and browsing
features.summary: Search and browse cached research with provenance.
features.purpose: Browse researched wiki content that has been imported and annotated with source provenance.
features.how_to_use: Search for the article by source, open the cached result and check its page identity and freshness. Use Sync & health or missing-page diagnostics when data is absent; a missing cache entry does not mean the underlying source page does not exist.
features.caveat: Missing cache results may reflect import coverage, not absence from the original wiki.

features.name: Wiki bulk import and sync
features.summary: Manage background scrape/import jobs and cache health.
features.purpose: Control batch scraping and importing of research pages and observe cache health.
features.how_to_use: Choose the Wiki source and import mode in Batch imports, set a bounded batch size, start the job and check progress or diagnostics before expanding scope. Prefer preview and validation for snapshot imports; preserve the original source and revision.
features.caveat: Large batches need source-specific rate and error handling; imported pages require provenance.

features.name: Wiki translation research
features.summary: Inspect Japanese translation and client terminology evidence.
features.purpose: Review Japanese terminology and translation evidence for client-research comparisons.
features.how_to_use: Compare the original term and source passage with the proposed translation; follow the supporting page and section references. Mark uncertain terms for review rather than treating a machine-produced equivalent as authoritative.
features.caveat: Machine or inferred translations require independent corroboration.

features.name: Key Item Lua evidence
features.summary: Inspect require, grant and remove references and source paths.
features.purpose: Locate script references that grant, require, or remove a key item.
features.how_to_use: Select a key item and inspect linked Lua source paths, constants and require/grant/remove operations. Check identifier lineage and guard context before inferring how the key item changes gameplay state.
features.caveat: A reference proves use in source, not that a complete quest progression is live-tested.

features.name: Item Browser
features.summary: Browse item records and inspect item data.
features.purpose: Browse item records and inspect item data.
features.how_to_use: Search by item name or ID, open the matching item, and check its record and related data references.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Item Editor
features.summary: Inspect and edit supported item data using guarded workflows.
features.purpose: Inspect and edit supported item data using guarded workflows.
features.how_to_use: Select an item by verified ID, review its supported editable fields and change preview, and use the guarded save workflow.
features.caveat: Review source, permissions, and target profile before any write; catalog presence does not prove live acceptance.

features.name: Missions
features.summary: Browse mission and progression evidence.
features.purpose: Browse mission and progression evidence.
features.how_to_use: Choose a nation or mission chain, inspect stage and script evidence, and follow relevant progression links.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Assault Tracker
features.summary: Track Assault issues, source evidence and validation gaps.
features.purpose: Track Assault missions, issue cross-references, shared dependencies, port status, and live-test readiness.
features.how_to_use: Open Assault, select a mission or zone, review the issue/fix-log evidence, and work from its next action.
features.caveat: Historical Topaz fixes do not automatically establish DSP fixes or validation.

features.name: Nyzul Isle
features.summary: Inspect Nyzul Isle domain data and related progression.
features.purpose: Inspect Nyzul Isle domain data and related progression.
features.how_to_use: Browse Nyzul floors, objectives, and tracked issues; inspect the associated script or server evidence before marking status.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Zones
features.summary: Browse zone data and linked research evidence.
features.purpose: Browse zone data and linked research evidence.
features.how_to_use: Search for a zone, inspect identity and source records, then open linked entities and spatial views.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Zone Editor
features.summary: Inspect zone entities and spatial evidence.
features.purpose: Inspect zone entities and spatial evidence.
features.how_to_use: Open the Zone Editor from a selected zone, identify the data source and target profile, then compare plotted server entities with live observations only when those observations are available. Inspect the selected spawn or entity before proposing changes and use guarded editing controls; do not interpret map alignment as runtime validation.
features.caveat: Review source, permissions, and target profile before any write; catalog presence does not prove live acceptance.

features.name: Model Viewer
features.summary: Inspect available client model assets.
features.purpose: Inspect available client model assets.
features.how_to_use: Choose an available client model asset, inspect its viewer output, and retain the source asset identity.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: DAT Inspector
features.summary: Inspect client DAT file evidence.
features.purpose: Inspect client DAT file evidence.
features.how_to_use: Select a client DAT file, inspect parsed structure and raw evidence, and compare results only across correctly identified client builds.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Retail Version Explorer
features.summary: Inspect retail manifest history and compare available versions.
features.purpose: Discover and selectively acquire versioned retail files for offline client research.
features.how_to_use: Open Retail Version Explorer, browse known files and revisions, then download into a dedicated research location before indexing.
features.caveat: Manifest history is not proof that every historical payload remains downloadable.

features.name: Retail Version Browser
features.summary: Browse discovered retail files and versions from a selected research snapshot.
features.purpose: Browse file identities and exact historical revisions from retail manifest snapshots.
features.how_to_use: In Retail Version Explorer, search the file name and review revisions in the manifest; confirm file identity and local availability before preparing a selective download. Do not execute retrieved retail binaries.
features.caveat: A listed historical revision does not guarantee that the remote payload still exists.

features.name: Dialog Drift
features.summary: Compare client dialog and text evidence.
features.purpose: Compare client dialog and text evidence.
features.how_to_use: Select dialogue records from two source snapshots, compare text or IDs, and inspect evidence for each difference.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Research Gaps
features.summary: Review missing or unresolved client research evidence.
features.purpose: Review missing or unresolved client research evidence.
features.how_to_use: Filter unresolved research questions by domain, follow evidence links, and record what still needs verification.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Dialog Browser
features.summary: Inspect dialog and text records.
features.purpose: Inspect dialog and text records.
features.how_to_use: Search dialogue identifiers or text, open source records, and inspect linked zone and event context.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Event Browser
features.summary: Inspect event and cutscene identifiers.
features.purpose: Inspect event and cutscene identifiers.
features.how_to_use: Select an event or cutscene ID, inspect source and zone associations, then follow implementation references.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Capture Search
features.summary: Search and correlate capture evidence.
features.purpose: Find packets, chat, entities, and other observations across imported capture evidence.
features.how_to_use: Choose events or packets mode in Capture Search, apply entity, opcode, module or text filters, then page through matches in their original capture context. Compare decoded fields with raw source evidence.
features.caveat: Results cover available indexed capture recordings only; empty matches are not evidence of absent gameplay behavior or a complete protocol corpus.

features.name: Discord Capture Archive
features.summary: Inspect imported capture-community posts, export sources and manually reconcile linked captures.
features.purpose: Browse archived Discord capture pointers without conflating third-party post metadata with game capture evidence.
features.how_to_use: Import only authorized Discord archive inventories locally before browsing. Filter posts by source channel/status, inspect HTTP(S) source links and optionally export a bounded review dataset. Use the link form only from the local Toolkit browser to connect a post to an existing capture ID; confirm the underlying file before marking it ingested.
features.caveat: Community links are unverified references. Absence of inventory tables produces an empty view, not an indexed collection. Similar filenames or shared URLs are candidate links, never automatic proof of ingestion. Local writes require same-origin browser access.

features.name: Capture Query
features.summary: Query indexed capture data.
features.purpose: Run structured queries against the indexed capture store.
features.how_to_use: Choose available capture fields and predicates, run the query and inspect matches with their capture IDs, timestamps and raw source observations. Confirm field decoding before using a result as proof of behavior.
features.caveat: Only captured and indexed fields can be queried reliably.

features.name: Validation Runs
features.summary: Browse recorded validation results.
features.purpose: Browse recorded validation results.
features.how_to_use: Select a validation run, review its results and evidence, then identify failed versus unexecuted checks.
features.caveat: Review source, permissions, and target profile before any write; catalog presence does not prove live acceptance.

features.name: Package Review
features.summary: Review migration package readiness and evidence.
features.purpose: Review migration package readiness and evidence.
features.how_to_use: Select the package and target root, run Review package, then examine the package summary, dependency scope, detailed decision ledger, execution plan and validation package before proposing promotion.
features.caveat: Package review is read-only: it requires a valid target root for readiness checks, reports review errors, and does not promote or write a package to the target.

features.name: Lua Converter
features.summary: Convert supported Lua references for backport workflows.
features.purpose: Convert supported Lua references for backport workflows.
features.how_to_use: Paste Topaz Lua source, choose the conversion target and, if needed, supply the zone ID-table name/shape and require() rename. Run Convert, inspect generated Lua and outstanding transformations, then manually compare identifiers and callbacks against the target tree before using the output.
features.caveat: This conversion preview does not write target files; review flagged transformations, source identifiers, and target profile before applying changes separately.

features.name: SQL Converter
features.summary: Convert supported SQL content for backport workflows.
features.purpose: Convert supported SQL content for backport workflows.
features.how_to_use: Choose a target table, paste one or more Topaz SQL statements, and run Convert. Examine converted SQL alongside ID collision and content-duplication checks; validate table/schema assumptions before applying output to any database.
features.caveat: The conversion preview may read a configured index for collision and content-duplication checks, but does not apply converted SQL to a server database. Review the schema and permissions before any separate write.

features.name: Binding Converter
features.summary: Inspect source binding and identifier conversion evidence.
features.purpose: Inspect source binding and identifier conversion evidence.
features.how_to_use: Inspect identifier or binding mappings, review proposed conversions and ambiguous matches before using converted content.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Live Target Validation
features.summary: Review live target validation workflow and its guarded operations.
features.purpose: Review live target validation workflow and its guarded operations.
features.how_to_use: Choose an authorized target and validation plan, inspect safeguards, execute permitted checks, and retain results.
features.caveat: Review source, permissions, and target profile before any write; catalog presence does not prove live acceptance.

features.name: Package Scope Review
features.summary: Review selected package content and dependency scope.
features.purpose: Review selected package content and dependency scope.
features.how_to_use: Select a migration ID and inspect the read-only GET dependency scope with query, decision and depth filters. A separate decision POST writes a node decision and resets the scope review to DRAFT. The review POST marks scope REVIEWED only when its closure checks permit it; inspect the resulting status before package creation.
features.caveat: GET scope filtering is read-only, but decision and review POST actions write canonical Workbench graph review state. The closure gate rejects BLOCKED or MANUAL_REQUIRED scope. These are not target server deployment operations.

features.name: Package Creation
features.summary: Prepare a package from reviewed source evidence.
features.purpose: Prepare a package from reviewed source evidence.
features.how_to_use: Choose a migration and source/target settings only after inspecting the reviewed dependency scope and its readiness gate. Submit Generate package, then inspect the materialized, missing and skipped artifacts; package creation is not target deployment.
features.caveat: Package materialization requires a canonical graph, existing migration actions and a reviewed dependency scope. A generated candidate does not imply deployment, target writes or gameplay acceptance.

features.name: Capture Format Support
features.summary: Review capture ingestion formats and known limitations.
features.purpose: Understand which logger and packet export formats the importer recognizes.
features.how_to_use: Consult Capture Format Support to confirm the accepted package structure, required metadata and parser expectations before importing. Keep unrecognized formats separate until the parser can report reliable diagnostics.
features.caveat: Parsing support varies by source; unsupported records must not be silently treated as valid.

features.name: Capture Path Visualization
features.summary: Inspect recorded spatial paths and visualizations.
features.purpose: Visualize player movement and other spatial paths recorded in captures.
features.how_to_use: Select a capture and zone, then inspect plotted points in time/order sequence. Check coordinate provenance and gaps before inferring a continuous route or comparing points to static zone entities.
features.caveat: Sparse updates and zoning can create apparent jumps; these are observations, not navigation instructions.

features.name: Capture Import
features.summary: Import recorded gameplay evidence into the capture workspace.
features.purpose: Ingest a recorded gameplay package into the Toolkit's research index.
features.how_to_use: Select the supported input capture, inspect the preview and parser diagnostics, then import only after confirming its origin. Review rejected or undecoded records afterward; a successful import does not imply full protocol decoding.
features.caveat: Import success does not guarantee every field was decoded or semantically interpreted.

features.name: Item Health
features.summary: Inspect item catalog health and evidence coverage.
features.purpose: Inspect item catalog health and evidence coverage.
features.how_to_use: Inspect item catalog diagnostics and inconsistent records; trace flagged issues to their data source.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Research Contradictions
features.summary: Review conflicting research evidence.
features.purpose: Review conflicting research evidence.
features.how_to_use: Open a conflicting research claim, compare the underlying sources, and leave the disagreement unresolved until evidence warrants a decision.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Research Evidence
features.summary: Browse recorded research evidence.
features.purpose: Browse recorded research evidence.
features.how_to_use: Open the research evidence view for the relevant session or source. Check original artifacts, source identity and any recorded relationships before carrying a finding into Feature Trace or a migration package.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Domains Overview
features.summary: Navigate domain-specific research and progression tools.
features.purpose: Navigate domain-specific research and progression tools.
features.how_to_use: Choose a game-system domain, review its tracked implementation and validation state, and navigate to linked records.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: Video OCR
features.summary: Inspect video-derived text research.
features.purpose: Inspect video-derived text research.
features.how_to_use: Select a video-derived text capture, inspect extracted text alongside source context, and confirm uncertain readings manually.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: LLM Research
features.summary: Explore local LLM-assisted research with source evidence safeguards.
features.purpose: Explore local LLM-assisted research with source evidence safeguards.
features.how_to_use: Provide a focused research question, review model-assisted findings with linked sources, and independently verify claims.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: All Capture Paths
features.summary: Review spatial paths across available captures.
features.purpose: Compare recorded routes across multiple capture sessions.
features.how_to_use: Choose a zone and the relevant capture sessions, compare their spatial overlays and identify differences in timing, sampling or coordinate frame before inferring repeated player routes.
features.caveat: Session coordinates and zone identity need reconciliation before comparing routes.

features.name: Bulk Capture Ingestion
features.summary: Manage bulk capture import workflow.
features.purpose: Process multiple capture sources in one bounded import workflow.
features.how_to_use: Review the source set and bulk-ingest plan before starting a batch. After processing, inspect per-file outcomes and skipped/failed entries; preserve original capture provenance and avoid retrying blindly.
features.caveat: Large imports can contain mixed formats; review error summaries rather than assuming complete coverage.

features.name: Capture Metadata Import
features.summary: Import supplementary capture metadata.
features.purpose: Associate supplementary metadata with already captured evidence.
features.how_to_use: Choose metadata for the exact capture identity, inspect the join keys and import preview, then verify the resulting associations. Do not attach unmatched metadata to a similarly named recording.
features.caveat: Metadata alone does not prove its corresponding packet/event occurred.

features.name: Capture Review Queue
features.summary: Review capture exceptions and ingestion evidence.
features.purpose: Inspect exceptions and uncertain ingestion results before trusting downstream analyses.
features.how_to_use: Open the capture review queue and examine the flagged candidate. Compare submitted text with the original material, then choose Use this post, Save what I typed, or dismiss the candidate when it is not a campaign capture; do not approve unsupported parsing assumptions.
features.caveat: An exception can be a decode ambiguity rather than a faulty source capture.

features.name: Capture Zone Review
features.summary: Review zone-linked capture evidence.
features.purpose: Review capture observations grouped by zone and spatial context.
features.how_to_use: Choose a zone in Capture Zone Review, inspect associated observations and unresolved entity IDs, then cross-reference server spawn data only when identities and coordinate bases match.
features.caveat: Zone mapping may be incomplete for unknown or stale session metadata.

features.name: Shift Master
features.summary: Inspect Shift Master domain workflow.
features.purpose: Inspect Shift Master domain workflow.
features.how_to_use: Open Shift Master domain research, inspect available workflow records and source evidence, and identify unvalidated behavior.
features.caveat: Research output depends on the available indexed sources; absence of evidence is not proof of absent behavior.

features.name: PE headers, imports and string evidence
features.summary: Inspect static PE sections, import/export tables, strings and byte patterns.
features.purpose: Inspect static PE sections, import/export tables, strings and byte patterns.
features.how_to_use: Open Binary Inspector, choose an isolated EXE/DLL path, optionally enter string or byte filters, and inspect evidence locations.
features.caveat: A match shows bytes present, not that the feature executes at runtime.

features.name: Binary feature probe sets
features.summary: Run predefined evidence searches against a selected client binary.
features.purpose: Run predefined evidence searches against a selected client binary.
features.how_to_use: Open Binary Inspector, choose a saved probe set, inspect its hit rows, then explicitly save observations to the graph only when intended.
features.caveat: A missed probe remains UNKNOWN and does not establish feature absence.

features.name: Binary version comparison
features.summary: Compare two isolated retail binary versions without executing them.
features.purpose: Compare two isolated retail binary versions without executing them.
features.how_to_use: Inspect the first client binary, set the diff-against path, and examine structural differences and supporting evidence.
features.caveat: Packed sections or changed compiler layouts can limit function-level conclusions.

features.name: Protocol compatibility evidence
features.summary: Inspect versioned, read-only packet layout research and its confidence labels.
features.purpose: Inspect versioned, read-only packet layout research and its confidence labels.
features.how_to_use: Open Binary Inspector's Protocol Compatibility section, compare build fingerprints, field offsets and source references.
features.caveat: INFERRED packet layouts must not be treated as runtime-verified compatibility.

features.name: Running client version scan
features.summary: Read a running client's version-string observations in a development session.
features.purpose: Read a running client's version-string observations in a development session.
features.how_to_use: From Binary Inspector select Scan running client, then examine reported process and address evidence.
features.caveat: Requires a running client and compatible access; an empty scan means UNKNOWN.

features.name: Retail manifest browser
features.summary: Find exact retail file names and revision stamps from the manifest.
features.purpose: Find exact retail file names and revision stamps from the manifest.
features.how_to_use: Open Retail Version Explorer's Manifest tab, search for a file, and inspect available revision history.
features.caveat: A listed historical version may not be downloadable.

features.name: Selective download planning
features.summary: Review a single-file retrieval plan before any bytes are acquired.
features.purpose: Review a single-file retrieval plan before any bytes are acquired.
features.how_to_use: Choose an exact manifest file and revision in the Planner, review destination and overwrite/hash safeguards, then confirm a selective download only when provenance is acceptable. Inspect the resulting local artifact independently.
features.caveat: Network operations require an authorized patch source; the plan itself is not a downloaded artifact.

features.name: Downloaded artifact catalog
features.summary: Inspect isolated retail files with recorded verification evidence.
features.purpose: Inspect isolated retail files with recorded verification evidence.
features.how_to_use: Open Local artifacts and review file hash, signature and manifest provenance before sending an artifact to Binary Inspector. Availability in the local folder does not establish integrity without the recorded checks.
features.caveat: A matching SHA-256 against the local output is not independently authenticated provenance.

features.name: Retail version comparison
features.summary: Compare cataloged revisions of the same client file.
features.purpose: Compare cataloged revisions of the same client file.
features.how_to_use: Select two independently identified revisions in Compare and inspect reported structural and content differences. Keep interpretation tied to file identities and do not infer behavior changes solely from hash differences.
features.caveat: Structural differences require additional evidence before making behavioral claims.

features.name: Feature Testing & Validation
features.summary: Design and inspect bounded test scenarios, assertion plans and imported observation runs.
features.purpose: Prepare test specifications and inspect run results without granting unapproved execution.
features.how_to_use: Open Feature Testing, choose a readiness case, build a scenario and review preflight, observed results and assertion differences. Open a run from Run history for a plain-language summary and the compared values; use Compare with another run to see two recorded runs side by side.
features.caveat: Design-only plans are not executable tests; execution support and live result evidence must be verified separately.

features.name: Run results and Compare runs
features.summary: Read an imported run in plain language and compare two recorded runs without running anything.
features.purpose: Let a person explain what a recorded run does and does not show, and whether two runs can be compared.
features.how_to_use: Open Run history, open a run for the What happened summary and the compared values for each step, then use Compare with another run to pick an earlier and a later run.
features.caveat: Read-only and based on imported reports, which are not independently authenticated. A verdict is what the report recorded. Compare runs reports whether a pair is comparable and why not; a comparable pair is only a candidate regression or fix and never shows a cause. Most real pairs are not comparable until the runner records environment and fixtures; rows imported before the importer recorded a definition fingerprint cannot be compared.

features.name: Guided scenario builder
features.summary: Choose observation fields and supported assertion templates for a test plan.
features.purpose: Construct a clear, source-aware set of checks before requesting operator execution.
features.how_to_use: Choose a versioned test definition and scenario, identify the approved account/context and review the generated test plan JSON. Check observation guides and assertions before saving a design; plan creation does not execute the scenario.
features.caveat: Test planning does not execute a scenario. A separate execution launch requires operator authorization and explicit approval; a queued job is not a completed or passing test. The field guide describes expected evidence, not guaranteed collection.

features.name: Imported observation run inspector
features.summary: Examine imported run results, failed assertions and their original evidence.
features.purpose: Inspect which assertions passed, failed or lack sufficient observation evidence.
features.how_to_use: Filter imported test runs by run ID, feature or verdict, open the exact run and inspect recorded observations, assertions and artifacts. Distinguish a failed assertion from a missing observation or unavailable test environment.
features.caveat: Imported observations are scoped to the run; filters and paginated history do not establish a passing run or general gameplay correctness.

features.name: Read-only test supervisor investigation
features.summary: Review bounded source candidates for a failed imported run.
features.purpose: Examine a failing assertion with its original run evidence and read-only source investigation.
features.how_to_use: Select the exact test definition/run and verify authorized local credentials and supervisor endpoint before requesting investigation. Review candidate diagnoses against raw evidence and preserve uncertainty; recommendations are not automated gameplay acceptance.
features.caveat: The gateway is authenticated and read-only; source ranking is not causal proof and does not enable execution.

features.name: Wiki evidence provenance and source drill-down
features.summary: Inspect source-qualified Wiki page documents and section-level evidence from Feature Trace.
features.purpose: Follow original Wiki citations while preserving the distinction between reference and server behavior.
features.how_to_use: Open Wiki-backed Evidence Dossier entries, compare original excerpt, source ID, page and section locator, then follow the exact Wiki source link. Keep extracted prose distinct from verified server behavior.
features.caveat: Source assertions remain review-only and duplicated headings may not be resolvable; local GUI acceptance is pending.

features.name: Exact Wiki source and section navigation
features.summary: Open original source-qualified Wiki articles and their evidence sections.
features.purpose: Reach the precise Wiki page linked from an evidence record without matching an ambiguous title.
features.how_to_use: From the Feature Trace dossier open the exact Wiki source page; inspect the focused section and original excerpt; verify source identity.
features.caveat: Section focus is conservative with duplicate headings; not every imported page retains all source fields.

features.name: Key Item lineage comparison
features.summary: Compare DSP, LSB and Topaz key-item references and mapping readiness.
features.purpose: Inspect which source mapping corresponds to a client key-item identity.
features.how_to_use: Search for the key item, confirm its source identity and compare Active DSP, LSB and optional Topaz mappings row by row. Treat missing or mismatched IDs as unresolved until sourced.
features.caveat: Reference mappings and backport readiness are not proof of in-game behavior.

features.name: Key Item Lua operation dependencies
features.summary: Inspect Lua requires, grants and removes for selected key items.
features.purpose: Find source-backed key-item condition and mutation references.
features.how_to_use: Choose a key item and source lineage, filter referenced Lua operations by require, grant or remove, and inspect each operation’s conditions and call site; a static reference is not an observed transition.
features.caveat: References depend on indexed script lineage, not runtime observation.

features.name: Key Item evidence and research handoff
features.summary: Open related Feature Trace, Wiki and Character Editor investigations.
features.purpose: Continue a specific key-item investigation without losing its source identity.
features.how_to_use: Review key item evidence and unresolved differences, then follow the exact Feature Trace, Wiki or Character Editor source link for the question being investigated. Retain originating IDs and citations.
features.caveat: Cross-module navigation does not establish that a captured or reference occurrence is causally related.

features.name: Validation run history
features.summary: Review prior validation outcomes and evidence at the run level.
features.purpose: Identify completed or incomplete validation work and its available evidence.
features.how_to_use: Select a recorded validation run and inspect its case ID, timestamp, inputs, assertions and artifacts. Separate test failures from missing evidence or a run that was never executed.
features.caveat: Run status and stored evidence must be reviewed; no validation is implied by route availability.

features.name: Live target validation
features.summary: Inspect an explicitly configured target and its supported validation checks.
features.purpose: Distinguish validation of a configured live target from source-level inspection.
features.how_to_use: Verify the configured target identity, prerequisites and permissions before explicitly executing any live target check. Inspect its recorded outcome and errors; configuration alone is not acceptance evidence.
features.caveat: A configured target or plan is not an executed or passing validation.
